title: Carolina Lenes Arreola
text: Carolina is a Colombian commercial and maritime lawyer currently completing a Master’s in Business Analytics at Baruch College. Her academic background also includes an Associate’s degree in Business Administration from LaGuardia Community College. After successfully completing her initial studies and post-graduation work, she continues to serve LaGuardia within the Division of Student Affairs for the ACCES Pre-ETS program. Carolina is looking to merge her legal expertise with advanced research and data analysis to drive strategic business insights.
